articles.title: When Relationships Change: Anne Morrow Lindbergh on Embracing the Intermittency and Mutability of Love
articles.highlight: 一切有生命的关系都处于变化与扩展的过程中，必须不断为自己建构新的形态。
articles.summary: 这篇来自《The Marginalian》的文章借安妮·默罗·林德伯格的文字，讨论爱与人际关系为何无法固定不变，而会以间歇、流动的方式持续演化。它值得非技术读者一读，因为它提供了一种看待长期关系与团队协作的视角：把变化视为关系存续的条件，而非关系出问题的信号。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键结论是：稳定的关系并不靠维持原状，而靠双方不断为它重建新的形态；把变化当成常态，期待就不再容易落空。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "All living relationships are in process of change, of expansion, and must perpetually be building themselves new forms."

articles.highlight: 针对稀疏或受损电极蒙太奇，TriRouter 以电极空间路由框架提升运动想象脑电解码的鲁棒性。
articles.summary: 论文关注运动想象脑机接口在多通道脑电采集中的实际难题：电极蒙太奇常出现稀疏或损坏。作者提出 TriRouter，一种电极空间路由框架，并涉及判别信息保持。其意义在于为不完整电极条件下的鲁棒解码提供新思路。
articles.failureAnalysis: 当前可见文本仅给出摘要开头与框架名称，缺少实验设置、数据集和量化结果，无法据此判断其相对现有方法的实际增益。对稀疏或损坏电极条件的鲁棒性仍需完整论文中的对照实验支持。
articles.sourceExcerpt: TRIROUTER: SPARSE-TO-DENSE ELECTRODE-SPACE ROUTING FOR ROBUST EEG MOTOR IMAGERY DECODING Ying Zhou1, Yaoxin Li2, Mengting Liu1∗ 1School of Biomedical Engineering, Shenzhen Campus of Sun Yat-sen University 2University of Waterloo ABSTRACT Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisi- tion often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing frame- work with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contri- butions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness.

articles.title: onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该GitHub仓库已有3276颗星和近期公开活动，目标是让AI模型通过一块7美元ESP32使用真实iPhone：以AirPlay作为视觉输入、USB HID作为触控/输入手段，并可接入任意OpenAI兼容的视觉模型。它不需要Mac、开发者账号或越狱，值得关注是因为它把AI代理落到真实移动设备上的成本压得很低，也暴露了硬件桥接、系统兼容和实际部署的工程边界。
articles.failureAnalysis: 最大风险在工程可靠性：AirPlay取屏和USB HID注入依赖iOS与设备状态，跨版本、跨机型容易出兼容问题，实时视觉模型的延迟和误判也会影响操控成功率。无需Mac、开发者账号或越狱降低了门槛，但也可能限制后台运行、权限和可自动化的应用范围。对普通用户而言，硬件连接、配置和维护仍有支持成本；真实iPhone上的隐私、账号安全、平台条款和设备保修也是落地约束。3276星说明关注度高，但不等同于稳定需求或可规模化部署验证。

en.highlight: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model—no Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.
en.summary: This GitHub repository, with 3,276 stars and recent public activity, aims to let an AI model operate a real iPhone through a $7 ESP32 using AirPlay for visual input and USB HID for input, with any OpenAI-compatible vision model. It avoids a Mac, developer account, and jailbreak, making it worth reading as a low-cost hardware bridge between AI agents and mobile devices and as a case study in deployment constraints.
en.failureAnalysis: The main risks are engineering reliability and support cost: AirPlay capture and USB HID injection depend on iOS and device states, vision-model latency and errors can reduce control success, and privacy, account security, platform terms, and warranty constrain real-world use. High star count signals attention, not validated demand or scalable deployment.
en.title: Open-source agent lets AI control a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32
